quarterly_data.quarter: Feirongda investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: it has several self-developed cooling products; its cooling products for servers and data centers include TIM materials, various heat sinks, fans, 3D VC heat sinks, single-phase liquid-cooling cold-plate modules, two-phase liquid-cooling cold-plate modules, flow controllers and CDUs; it has reached supply cooperation with mainstream domestic server makers and some products are already delivered in volume, while it keeps holding business contacts and talks with other quality customers in the industry. Asked about overseas compute customers' liquid-cooling certification, it said cooperation details cannot be disclosed because of customer requirements and confidentiality agreements.
